claim: server/rateLimit.ts sweeps expired entries only when map size > 10_000, never evicts live keys, so unlimited fresh keys (req.ip full IPv6 address) grow the map and every request scans it once past 10k: measured 0.5us@5k, 238us@20k, 1.25ms@60k, 1.8ms@120k keys. Also gives fresh buckets per IPv6 address bypassing 10/min sign-in limit.
notes: Blockers: Cloud Run IPv6 reachability and XFF value; attacker needs >10k distinct source addresses in a window.
